protocol: prereg step 4: proposals pooled, provenance stripped, stable-sha256 order, independent Sonnet auditor sees ONLY round1_proposals_blinded.json; disagreements with the proposing track adjudicated by a frontier (Opus) arbiter

final.name: Applied-domain framing outside core machine learning
final.audit_justification: This scores subject-matter topic (application domain vs core ML) rather than any property of the reasoning or evidence, and explicitly says core-ML work scores 0 regardless of quality.

final.name: Abstract length and verbosity
final.audit_justification: This is pure surface length/verbosity, and the instruction explicitly disclaims judging whether that length is warranted.

final.name: Explanatory mechanism — says WHY the approach should work
final.audit_justification: Distinguishing an abstract that gives a causal/conceptual reason for why a method should work from one that just asserts good performance tracks real explanatory depth of the contribution.

final.name: States the costs, limitations, or failure conditions of its own method
final.audit_justification: Whether a paper honestly discloses costs, limitations, or failure regimes rather than presenting an unqualified win is a genuine mark of scientific honesty and rigor.

final.name: Ambition of the claim together with the specificity of the evidence offered for it
final.audit_justification: Calibrating claim size against evidentiary specificity (rewarding matched pairs, penalizing big claims on thin evidence) is a substantive epistemic property of the work, not a surface feature.

final.name: Theoretical claims tied to the proposed method with stated scope
final.audit_justification: Requiring theory to be specific to the method with stated scope/assumptions (versus a generic guarantees mention) tracks genuine theoretical rigor.

final.name: Reframing — recasts the problem in a different formalism or abstraction
final.audit_justification: Recasting a problem in a different formalism and naming both the old and new framing is a genuine form of conceptual insight, though it borders on a rhetorical/expository move rather than new evidence or reasoning.

final.name: Branded method name or acronym
final.audit_justification: This is explicitly a branding/naming convention (coined acronym, repeated through the text) and says to score the branding practice only, independent of the method's substance.

final.name: Motivation explains why the problem is hard, not merely that it is unaddressed
final.audit_justification: Requiring the motivation to state a substantive obstacle or structural difficulty, rather than merely noting a gap exists, tracks the depth of the problem analysis itself.

final.name: Breadth and diversity of the empirical evaluation actually enumerated
final.audit_justification: Counting genuinely distinct evaluation settings actually reported is a direct measure of empirical rigor and evidentiary breadth.

final.name: Technical specificity — the method's objects and operations are named precisely
final.audit_justification: Precision in naming the method's actual objects and operations (versus vague buzzwords like 'framework' or 'mechanism') reflects real clarity and substance of the technical contribution.

final.name: Contributions are separable components each with a stated role
final.audit_justification: Requiring each contribution piece to have a stated role (not just be listed) is about the abstract's honesty and clarity in accounting for what the work actually contributes, though it edges toward expository organization.

final.name: Enumerated list formatting inside the abstract
final.audit_justification: This explicitly scores list/numbering formatting regardless of what the items say, making it a pure presentation-format criterion.

final.name: Raw LaTeX or markup residue left in the abstract
final.audit_justification: Unrendered LaTeX/markdown residue is a typesetting artifact of the submission process, unrelated to the merit of the research.

final.name: Diagnoses a specific failure mode of prior work with stated evidence
final.audit_justification: Identifying a concrete, evidenced defect in prior work (versus a vague 'prior work is limited' claim) is a genuine mark of critical, well-grounded scholarship.

final.name: Magnitude of the engineering or data resource the work required
final.audit_justification: This rewards sheer scale of resources expended (corpora built, systems trained, annotations collected) rather than the quality of reasoning or evidence, making it closer to an institutional-resource signal than a merit of the contribution.

arbiter.model: Opus (frontier arbiter, given criterion text + auditor verdict + proposer rationale)
arbiter.reason: Collinear with the already-declared industrial-compute nuisance on its own exemplars (340M-image corpus, 7B/13B/33B models); it scores expended input (authors' circumstances) rather than a property of the contribution. Salvage rewrite offered for a later round: score artifact REUSABILITY (novelty, documentation, fitness for reuse), explicitly scale-invariant.

final.name: Reports a surprising, negative, or self-undercutting finding
final.audit_justification: Reporting a result against the authors' own convenient narrative (a failure, an upset baseline, a contradicted assumption) is a strong, substantive signal of scientific honesty.

final.name: Density of promotional superlatives and hype vocabulary
final.audit_justification: This counts promotional/hype vocabulary explicitly independent of whether the underlying claims are true, so it tracks rhetorical register, not substance.

final.name: Generality demonstrated beyond the primary setting rather than asserted
final.audit_justification: Requiring generality to be demonstrated with a reported case (versus merely asserted as 'plug-and-play') is a genuine evidentiary strength of the work.

final.name: Topic sits in a currently dominant research area
final.audit_justification: This explicitly scores topic fashionability/centrality to currently dominant ML subfields, and states a careful paper on an unfashionable topic should score low, which is the definition of a topic-not-merit criterion.

final.name: Quantified headline result against a named baseline or prior record
final.audit_justification: Requiring the headline result to be a specific number against a specifically named baseline (versus an unquantified 'state-of-the-art' claim) is a real measure of evidentiary specificity.

final.name: Famous benchmark and dataset name-dropping
final.audit_justification: This counts recognizable benchmark/dataset names for their fame rather than judging whether the evaluation is appropriate (explicitly disclaimed), making it closer to prestige name-dropping than an evaluation-quality measure.

final.name: Human or expert judgment used as evaluation evidence
final.audit_justification: Whether an evaluation includes human/expert judgment rather than resting solely on automatic metrics is a substantive methodological choice bearing on evidentiary strength.

final.name: Anonymized-repository or release-on-acceptance code boilerplate
final.audit_justification: Anonymized-repo links and release-on-acceptance promises are submission-time procedural boilerplate, explicitly scored by presence/prominence rather than by whether sharing is good practice.

final.name: Signals of industrial-scale compute or frontier proprietary models
final.audit_justification: Signals of proprietary-model access, GPU counts, or model/corpus scale track institutional resources available to the authors, not the quality of the reasoning or evidence in the work.
